newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT gets SEC nod on capital hike.
newsitem.headline: PLDT gets SEC nod on capital hike.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved the increase in authorized capital stock of Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co to 8.5 billion pesos from 4.5 billion pesos, the Philippine Stock Exchange said on Friday.
The new capital structure called for an increase in the number of preferred shares to 783 million from 383 million shares, which will have the same par value of ten pesos each.
The number of common shares stayed at 134 million at the same par value of five pesos each.

PLDT officials had said the increase in the number of preferred shares is in conjunction with the company's line expansion programme. As part of the installation fee, new telephone subscribers are required to subscribe to a certain number of preferred shares.
